alerts.headline: Extreme Heat Warning issued August 27 at 4:52AM PDT until August 28 at 8:00PM PDT by NWS Las Vegas NV
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Dangerously hot conditions expected through the work week,
with temperatures up to 115 to 118 across Death Valley and the
Colorado River Valley; up to 108 to 112 across Moapa Valley, the
Las Vegas Valley, the Pahrump Valley, and the Morongo Valley; up to
90 to 95 in the Hualapai Mountains. Overnight lows will be in the
upper-80s to low-90s for desert valleys.

* WHERE...Portions of northwest Arizona, southeast California, and
southern Nevada.

* WHEN...Until 8 PM PDT /8 PM MST/ Friday.
alerts.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids, stay in an air-conditioned room, stay out of
the sun, and check up on relatives and neighbors.

Do not leave young children and pets in unattended vehicles. Car
interiors will reach lethal temperatures in a matter of minutes.
